# v2.94

**This stable release rolls up dev pre-release v2.94-dev.** It is a small
housekeeping release with no effect on a running system, published so the stable
and dev channels stay in step after the v2.93 security release.

## Changed

- **The development server no longer edits `CLAUDE.md` on startup.** Next.js
  16.3 added a feature that writes a block of its own text into that file every
  time the development server starts. It reached this project as a side effect
  of the dependency upgrade in v2.87, and it only ever ran in development —
  production servers build and start the app, so they were never affected.

  The result was that the file showed up as changed in Git for no reason anyone
  had caused, which is an easy thing to "tidy up" with a command that also throws
  away genuine edits sitting alongside it. The feature is now turned off via its
  documented setting, so the file only changes when someone changes it.

## Upgrading

No database changes and no configuration. Nothing to do.

If you are coming from **v2.90 or earlier**, note that **v2.93 was a security
release** covering backup restore, the server's scheduled jobs, import limits and
two-factor enrolment for suspended accounts — see the v2.93 notes, and take that
update promptly if you have not already.
